no_adcom_quote.quote: No ODAC was convened for this application.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the TALZENNA (talazoparib) NDA 211651. The Multi-discipline Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states plainly that no ODAC (Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee) meeting was held. Accordingly, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
